source: Source: Sektionsdata webb, base database revision 2611030923, exported 2026-11-20. Click a component ID to open its full content. Costs excl. VAT, no waste.
readme: 1. Overview = the component tree / chapter view: chapter → sub-chapter → component with section cost, unit and technical values (like the chapter view in the program).

2. One sheet per chapter = the component content for every component: the same columns as in the program (No, BSAB, Description, Quantity, Unit, Material, Supplier, Time, UE, Other, Total, Discount, Waste, Trade, Account, PE code, P2 code, Weight, W-class, kg CO2e, CO2 class) plus unit values, followed by Sum, Overhead mark-up, Section cost and Total incl. overheads.
3. Price list = all articles with price, time, weight and CO2.
4. Settings = wage and mark-ups (blue cells). Sums, overheads and section costs are formulas and recalculate when you change them.
Grey indented rows are parts of a sub-component (e.g. a roof ridge) and are already included in that sub-component row; they are not double-counted.
The "Wikells" value next to the section cost is Sektionsdata's own figure, for checking.
CO2e = weight × typical CO2e per kg (A1–A3 as given by Wikells). Conservative = × 1.25.
Chapters 22–30 (UNASSIGNED) are empty placeholders and left out.
Descriptions translated from Swedish by Claude; IDs and codes unchanged. Data licensed from Wikells Byggberäkningar AB.
